methods.name: consolidated control barrier function (C-CBF)
methods.description: smoothly synthesizes multiple candidate CBFs into one, combined with a parameter adaptation law which renders the candidate C-CBF valid for safe control design

methods.name: Control Barrier Function (CBF)
methods.description: A function H on set S ensuring controlled invariance over safe sets under the condition LFH(x,k) + LGH(x,k)u >= -alpha_H(H(x,k)) for static gain vector k

methods.name: Online adaptation of gain vector k
methods.description: Online adaptation of the gain vector k to avoid LGH(x) = 0 and maintain state invariance

methods.name: centralized CBF-QP controller
methods.description: optimization-based controller replacing (8) to consolidate constituent constraints into one CBF condition

methods.name: decentralized CBF-QP controller
methods.description: controller replacing (7) in the presence of non-communicative agents

methods.name: C-CBF controller
methods.description: Controller demonstrated on a decentralized multi-robot goal-reaching problem.

methods.name: dynamic extension of the kinematic bicycle model
methods.description: Motion model used to govern robot position, heading angle, slip angle, and velocity.

methods.name: Decentralized Control Design using CBFs
methods.description: A decentralized controller where each agent computes inputs based on local information by solving a quadratic program that minimizes deviation from a nominal control input subject to linear safety constraints encoded via candidate Control Barrier Functions (CBFs).
